title: Pikmin 4
description: Pikmin 4 expands Nintendo’s miniature strategy-adventure formula with a customizable Rescue Corps rookie, the canine companion Oatchi, Ice Pikmin, Glow Pikmin, deeper cave expeditions, nighttime missions, and Dandori challenges. It is designed to be accessible to newcomers while giving series veterans a large campaign with layered exploration and postgame content.

gameplayPillars.title: Oatchi companion systems
gameplayPillars.description: Ride Oatchi, command him independently, carry heavy objects, battle creatures, and upgrade his skills.

gameplayPillars.title: New Pikmin types
gameplayPillars.description: Ice Pikmin can freeze water and enemies, while Glow Pikmin appear in nighttime expeditions.

gameplayPillars.title: Caves and layered exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Caves return with multi-level structures, treasure hunts, hazards, bosses, and flexible planning.

gameplayPillars.title: Dandori efficiency challenges
gameplayPillars.description: Timed challenges test route planning, task division, resource gathering, and tactical speed.

gameplayPillars.title: Night expeditions
gameplayPillars.description: Defend Lumiknolls after dark using Glow Pikmin in a different style of mission from daytime exploration.

worldSummary: The game transforms ordinary human environments into enormous miniature landscapes, including gardens, interiors, caves, beaches, and nighttime zones full of hidden treasures and creatures.

storyChapters.title: Join the Rescue Corps
storyChapters.body: A new recruit arrives to help a rescue mission after Captain Olimar and other castaways become stranded.

storyChapters.title: Meet and train Oatchi
storyChapters.body: The Rescue Pup becomes central to carrying, fighting, exploration, and puzzle solving.

storyChapters.title: Recover castaways and treasure
storyChapters.body: Every area contains stranded people, resources, and treasures that expand the Rescue Corps’ capabilities.

storyChapters.title: Explore caves and night missions
storyChapters.body: The campaign layers conventional daytime maps with caves and defensive nighttime expeditions.

storyChapters.title: Push into the late rescue operation
storyChapters.body: New zones, Dandori challenges, and post-story objectives significantly extend the adventure beyond the early rescue goal.

features: Oatchi changes traversal and strategy dramatically
Ice and Glow Pikmin add new tactical roles
Caves and nighttime missions diversify exploration
Large campaign with extensive postgame content
Excellent onboarding for new Pikmin players

faq.a: Yes. Tutorials, Oatchi, rewind features, and gradual system introductions make it one of the easiest entries to start with.
Yes. Oatchi gains skills and upgrades that improve carrying, combat, traversal, and independent task handling.
The game includes local two-player support elements and Dandori content, but it is primarily structured as a single-player adventure.
Yes, through Nintendo Switch backward compatibility.
No major paid expansion pass is required for the core Pikmin 4 experience.

verdictPros: Deepest and most approachable Pikmin campaign
Oatchi is useful without replacing Pikmin strategy
Large amount of content and postgame objectives
verdictCons: Some early sections are very forgiving
Secondary-player support is limited compared with full co-op
Veterans may miss aspects of Pikmin 3’s captain multitasking
